offering_description.value: CuriosityStream produces, commissions and acquires documentaries and other factual programming. It streams that programming to viewers and licenses programs and footage to businesses. It also distributes television channels and offers online lectures and educational audio.

primary_products.value: documentary films and series; licensable video footage; recorded lectures and courses; educational podcasts

primary_services.value: subscription video streaming; linear and ad-supported channel programming; online learning

customer_segment.value: B2C: documentary viewers and adult learners; B2B: broadcasters, streaming platforms, pay-TV operators, AI developers and advertisers

end_markets.value: home entertainment; television and streaming media; AI development; adult education; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring access to documentary streaming and online lectures; licensing or royalties: rights to distribute programming or use video footage and libraries; advertising: ad placements on free streaming channels

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: streams original and acquired factual programming to subscribers; OEM / manufacturer: develops and produces original factual films and series for viewers and media licensees; distributor: packages original and acquired programming for broadcasters, pay-TV operators and streaming partners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: documentary streaming, program and footage licensing, factual television channels, online lectures and educational audio

distribution_channels.value: online: company websites and apps on mobile devices and connected TVs; partners / resellers: pay-TV operators, streaming marketplaces and free streaming platforms; direct sales: program and footage licensing agreements with media companies and other businesses

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: streaming viewer data and recurring billing are subject to privacy and consumer protection rules, including GDPR and FTC requirements

notes: The current relative scale of subscriptions and licensing is uncertain.
